The DAO was a decentralized autonomous organization built on the Ethereum blockchain. The DAO was governed by its token holders through voting on proposals. The DAO launched in April 2016 and raised funds through a crowdsale denominated in ether. The DAO was exploited in June 2016 through a reentrancy vulnerability in its smart contracts. The DAO's exploit led to a hard fork that created the Ethereum (ETH) and Ethereum Classic chains.

Uranium Finance is a decentralized exchange that uses an automated market maker model. Uranium Finance operates on the Binance Smart Chain. Uranium Finance was launched in 2021. Uranium Finance suffered a hack in April 2021 that resulted in large losses of user funds.

Kyber is an on-chain liquidity protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Kyber enables token swaps through smart contracts without a centralized intermediary. Kyber uses its native token KNC for network participation.
